description: An echo modelled on the Binson Echorec, where the signal is written to a spinning magnetic disk and read back by six play heads at once

params.text: How fast the disk turns, which sets how far apart the repeats fall
The level of the incoming signal
The playback level of that head
How much of the heads' output is written back onto the disk; turned up alongside the repeat knobs it builds to very high levels
The balance between the dry signal and the echoes
Tap it in time and the disk speed follows the interval between the taps
Scales the CV changing the disk speed
How much of that head's output is sent back to be written on the disk again
Passes the input straight to the outputs with no echo

inputs.text: The signal recorded onto the disk
A signal written onto the disk at that head's position
Pulses here set the disk speed from the interval between them
A CV changing the disk speed
A CV changing the input level
A voltage switches the bypass on and off

outputs.text: The output of that head on its own
